notes: Sortable drilldown tables — click any column header on a finding's drilldown (Identity, Conditional Access) to sort ascending, click again for descending, again to reset. Sort state persists per-finding across navigation and reload
Persistent drilldown column widths — drag a divider to widen a column and that width sticks per-finding, so your preferred layout doesn't reset every time you reopen the row
Empty-state polish — Tenant Activity tab and the Reports → Export licensing data page now render the same green-check empty treatment as the rest of the portal when there's nothing to show
